title: Saamarth City
tagline: Harmony Haven: a luxurious urban oasis
description: A 4-BHK luxury bungalow. Plot 2,480 sq.ft; built-up 4,610 sq.ft.

This design concept embodies a serene and refined aesthetic, where every carefully curated element contributes to an ambiance of understated elegance. By embracing the principles of minimalism, the house strikes a balance between luxury and tranquility — clean, uncluttered lines, and rooms that feel finished without being overworked.

title: Mr. Rao's Residency
description: A 3-BHK apartment. Carpet 1,255 sq.ft; built-up 2,340 sq.ft.
From the warm bedroom to the efficient kitchen, every detail is meant to elevate an urban apartment into a home that matches the client's lifestyle — contemporary, practical, and quietly finished.

title: Mrs. Jaya's Residency
description: Within this spacious 4-BHK residence in Noida, the renovation focused on transforming the bedroom into a private retreat of comfort and function. The space was reworked with a refreshed false ceiling design, incorporating cove and profile lighting to create a warm, layered ambience. Thoughtful space planning maximized every corner, ensuring smooth movement and a clutter-free layout. A custom-built wardrobe was designed for ample storage, complemented by a dedicated dresser area that blends functionality with everyday elegance. Together, these elements bring a sense of calm sophistication to the room — proving that a well-planned bedroom can feel like a home within a home.

title: Mr. Akshay's Residency
description: A 4-BHK modular apartment. Carpet 1,375.5 sq.ft; built-up 1,965 sq.ft.

A timeless blend of sophistication and ease: rooms that open into each other, materials that stay quiet, and a plan that treats luxury as something you live in — not something you look at from the doorway.

title: Corks and Curds
tagline: A curated wine and cheese experience
description: We are building a curated culinary platform that brings together premium wines and artisanal cheeses through thoughtfully designed pairing experiences. Each combination is selected based on flavor, texture, intensity, and balance to create a refined experience where the characteristics of both products complement and enhance one another.

The platform will enable customers to discover and explore curated wine-and-cheese pairings, understand the reasoning behind each combination, and purchase selected products for their own experience. In addition to curated pairings, it will feature a dedicated selection of ready-to-enjoy cheese products and a recipe section offering practical inspiration for incorporating these products into meals, gatherings, and at-home dining.

The goal is to simplify premium food discovery by combining expert curation, product commerce, and culinary inspiration into a seamless experience that helps customers discover new flavors and confidently recreate exceptional pairings at home.

title: 3D Visuals
tagline: Photoreal stills for residences and hospitality
description: Includes work such as Ashiana — A Refined Retreat (Ankit Chaudhary, with Gaurang Patel Architects, Gandhinagar, 2023–24), Coral Hostel: Solitaire Mansion (2024), and Jinagar Samaj: Willow Brook luxury bungalow (Gandhinagar, with Gaurang Patel Architects).
These visualisations are photoreal and stylised scenes that hold form, material, and spatial composition. Lighting, texture, and viewpoint are used to carry design intent before anything is built.

title: Construction Drawings
description: Working drawings for Saamarth City, Rao's Residency, and Tanmay Jani's Residency.
These are the scaled sheets used to build: dimensions, materials, and notes required for accurate work on site — the drawings that take a design from screen to structure.
